notes.list.statement: SELECT id, title, created_at FROM notes WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

notes.create.statement: INSERT INTO notes (owner_id, title, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)

notes.batch.guard: No notes were added because the batch is empty or has invalid titles.
notes.batch.statement: INSERT INTO notes (owner_id, title, created_at) SELECT ?1, item.value, ?2 FROM json_each(?3) AS item WHERE json_valid(?3) AND json_type(?3) = 'array' AND json_array_length(?3) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?3) AS candidate WHERE candidate.type != 'text' OR length(trim(candidate.value)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

notes.delete.statement: DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ? AND owner_id = ?
